brief: A kitchen herb planter: three bins on bases, filled with soil and planted with basil, thyme and mint.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:1,-1,0;full each holds bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:1,-1,0~hex-bin-full
fillSoil on all three bins, verified by get_build soil entries

finish.summary: Built L-shaped trio of bases with full-depth bins, filled soil and planted basil, thyme and mint respectively. Joint bolts secure the cluster, mesh clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
